verdict.rationale: mParticle versions its APIs per surface and documents migrations, such as the Data Subject Request API v1/v2→v3 upgrade guide with a new v3 base URL and a Warehouse Sync API v2 migration. It also keeps a dated changelog. However, the evidence explicitly notes that no policy page states notice periods or lifecycle guarantees, so the deprecation-policy half of the story is unmet. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice periods and lifecycle/sunset guarantees, consistent versioning across all API surfaces (Events/Platform/Profile), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: mParticle versions its APIs per surface with documented migrations
